# Marketplace gives pharmacies access to thousands of uniquely curated front-of-store products

We’re reimagining the procurement process by enabling pharmacies to source all the products they
need from front to back through one convenient platform.
[ Learn more ][87]
[A person viewing the Marketplace homepage on their laptop]

## We are united in our responsibility
## to create healthier futures.

As we pursue our purpose, we make a positive impact on the health of people and animals around the
world.

### Pharmaceutical distribution solutions

Our wholesale and specialty distribution services ensure that crucial medications efficiently,
reliably and securely reach their destinations every day.
[ Learn more ][88]
[AB_1Card_03]

In addition to distribution and logistics, we help pharmaceutical manufacturers bring their products
to market – and assist with each step from pre-commercial and clinical trial to broad market
availability and patient adherence.

[ Learn more ][90]

# We are now Cencora. Our shared identity unites us.

Cencora brings the companies and services of AmerisourceBergen together under one new name.

[ Meet Cencora ][86]
[A banner that says We Are Cencora on a pink and purple background]

# Marketplace gives pharmacies access to thousands of uniquely curated front-of-store products

We’re reimagining the procurement process by enabling pharmacies to source all the products they
need from front to back through one convenient platform.
[ Learn more ][87]
[A person viewing the Marketplace homepage on their laptop]

## We are united in our responsibility
## to create healthier futures.

As we pursue our purpose, we make a positive impact on the health of people and animals around the
world.

### Pharmaceutical distribution solutions

Our wholesale and specialty distribution services ensure that crucial medications efficiently,
reliably and securely reach their destinations every day.
[ Learn more ][88]
[AB_1Card_03]

### Manufacturer solutions

In addition to distribution and logistics, we help pharmaceutical manufacturers bring their products
to market – and assist with each step from pre-commercial and clinical trial to broad market
availability and patient adherence.
[ Learn more ][89]
[AB_2_3_Card_03]

### Provider solutions

Our solutions power patient care for pharmacies, physician practices, hospitals and health systems.
[ Learn more ][90]
[AB_2_3_Card_05]

### Animal health solutions

We deliver distribution, technology and innovation for veterinarians, livestock producers and
manufacturers to make a meaningful difference in their businesses and the health of animals.
[ Learn more ][91]
[GettyImages-907614352_JPG]

## In the news

Read the latest press releases and media mentions.
[ Explore newsroom ][92]

## Insights

Access the newest in thought leadership.
[ Explore insights ][93]

# Careers with purpose

With a global presence and 44,000+ team members strong, AmerisourceBergen is committed to making a
difference in the future of health.
[ Explore careers ][94]

# Building a world of health around every individual

We connect people to the care they need, put medicine and wellness within reach, and drive greater
affordability, simplicity and convenience in everything we do.

## Combining our strengths for you

Health services Health insurance Pharmacy Prescription drug coverage

### Health services

We have an unmatched ability to reach people and provide them with access to the affordable, quality
health care and wellbeing services they need to live their healthiest lives.

[Explore our services ][110]

### Health insurance

Aetna® creates insurance plans that deliver a total, connected, affordable approach to health care.

[Discover Aetna plans ][111]

### Pharmacy

Our neighborhood pharmacies — as well as our prescription delivery and specialty medication services
— are making it as easy as possible for people to get the care they depend on.

[Visit our pharmacy page ][112]

### Prescription drug coverage

Our pharmacy benefit manager, CVS Caremark®, plays a critical role in the health care system by
helping to lower drug costs and expand coverage to the affordable medications people need to stay
healthy.

[Learn about drug coverage ][113]

Having 1 kid?...Not exactly simple.

Having 6 kids? Definitely not simple. Wait, that’s 8 people in one family. Whoa.

That means finding ONE tv show they’ll ALL watch.

Making ONE dinner they’ll ALL eat.

And how do you play a board game with 6 kids?…actually, that’s kinda simple.

Okaaay, not so simple.

But it’s not just tantrums.

It’s attitudes.

That’s right. Teenagers.

And how do you decide who gets the last piece of pizza?

But you don’t just have 6 kids, you have 6 kids all with chronic illnesses.

That means on top of it all, you have to manage over 50 prescriptions, medical checkups, and support
everyone’s mental health.

Luckily, you’re not alone…I mean Tricia, obviously YOU’RE not alone.

But you’ve also got CVS Health as your healthcare partner, to manage specialty medications, provide
walk-in appointments, and keep track of it all in the CVS Health app.

So, does that make everything…simple?

No. It makes it simple…er

And sometimes, “simpler” is all you need to live a little happier and healthier.

But who gets the last piece of pizza? That’s still your call.

When you need more than a pharmacy…
CVS Health.
Healthier Happens Together.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

Thomas Schinecker said: “2025 was a strong year for Roche, reflecting our continued focus on
operational and R&D excellence.”

## We are Roche

We combine life-changing diagnostics and medicines to take on the toughest healthcare challenges,
those that place the greatest strain on patients, families, communities, and health systems. 

Guided by the experiences of patients, we are determined to prevent, stop and cure diseases so
people can live healthier, longer lives.

[Man holding a surfing board smiling with a ocean in the background.]

gestures while speaking, and the other listens attentively with a slight smile.]

We prevent diseases by identifying high-risk patients early to enable timely use of medicines.

Our strategy

Our diagnostics solutions

### Restoring health through medicines

We cure diseases by identifying the cause of a patient’s condition and restoring health through
curative medicines.

Our pharma solutions

# Harness the Power.
# Open the Possibilities.

Stabilizing the immune response. Enabling optimism for patients with inflammatory disease.

[Our Mission][28]

Learn how obefazimod is believed to work.

## Our Scientific Journey

### Novel Mechanism of Action (MOA)

Our researchers discovered a molecule with a novel MOA that harnesses the power of microRNA
biology—specifically miR-124. This molecule, obefazimod, enhances the expression of miR-124, a
naturally occurring microRNA that plays a critical role in regulating the immune response.

### Therapeutic Innovation

We are on a scientific journey to explore how this new approach could be used to treat chronic
inflammatory diseases. Our discovery has provided the opportunity to bring an innovative approach to
treating inflammation.

[Find Out How][29]

Targeting Inflammatory Diseases

### Our Science

Under dysregulated inflammatory conditions in preclinical studies, enhanced expression of miR-124
resulted in stabilized levels of multiple cytokines and chemokines, bringing them back to
homeostatic levels. Simultaneously restoring multiple pathways to homeostatic levels may lower the
potential for compensatory immune escape mechanisms, which may result in more durable, long-term
efficacy.

[Our SCIENTIFIC FOCUS][30]

### Our Lead Drug Candidate

Obefazimod is an investigational, orally administered, once-daily small molecule in clinical
development with a novel mechanism of action. It is the first and only molecule to enhance the
expression of miR-124 in immune cells, a natural regulator of the inflammatory response.

[Our INVESTIGATIONAL THERAPY][31]

### Our Research

Our primary goal is to develop and commercialize obefazimod for the treatment of inflammatory
diseases, starting with ulcerative colitis. We announced positive top-line results from the 8-week
induction trials of obefazimod in July 2025 and positive top-line results from 44-week maintenance
data in June 2026, marking key milestones in our clinical development program.

Patient enrollment for ENHANCE-CD in Crohn’s disease was initiated in Q3 2024; 12-week induction
data readout is anticipated mid-year 2027.

[Read the results][32]

### Our Pipeline

We are exploring the development of obefazimod for other inflammatory indications while
simultaneously investigating follow-on compounds.

Abivax also owns a proprietary chemical library that we believe contains further untapped potential.
We have launched a research program to turn that potential into a reality.

[Our PRODUCT DEVELOPMENT PORTFOLIO][33]

Frequently Asked Questions

## Answers for International Patients

Our international patient advisors are here to help you, 24/7.

**Still have questions?** [Talk to an Advisor][77]
01What exactly does Acıbadem Health Point do for me?

We are your single point of contact for treatment in Türkiye — reviewing your case with the right
specialists, building a clear plan and estimate, and coordinating every detail from your first
question to your recovery back home.

02How do I start, and what does it cost to ask?

Share your reports or simply describe your situation. A specialist reviews your case and you receive
a tailored plan with transparent cost information. The initial assessment costs you nothing.

03Can I speak to a doctor before deciding to travel?

Yes. You can request a written second opinion or a secure video consultation with an Acıbadem
specialist, so you decide with full confidence before booking anything.

04Will I be understood in my own language?

A dedicated multilingual team and professional interpreters support you before, during and after
treatment, so nothing is lost between you and your doctors.

05Are the hospitals and doctors truly world-class?

Care is delivered in JCI-accredited hospitals by physicians recognised internationally in their
fields, using the same advanced technology and protocols you would expect from a leading global
centre.

06What happens after I return home?

Your treatment does not end at discharge. You leave with full medical documentation and a direct
line back to your care team for follow-up questions and ongoing guidance.

## More Than Healthcare

Acibadem is far more than a group of hospitals. It is a fully integrated healthcare ecosystem —
bringing together a leading medical university, dedicated research institutes, advanced diagnostic
laboratories, pioneering digital-health platforms and specialised sports-medicine expertise. Every
element works in concert, so that each international patient benefits from shared knowledge,
continuous innovation and genuinely compassionate care, delivered to one consistent standard across
the entire network.

Frequently Asked Questions

## Answers for International Patients

Our international patient advisors are here to help you, 24/7.

**Still have questions?** [Talk to an Advisor][77]
01What exactly does Acıbadem Health Point do for me?

We are your single point of contact for treatment in Türkiye — reviewing your case with the right
specialists, building a clear plan and estimate, and coordinating every detail from your first
question to your recovery back home.

02How do I start, and what does it cost to ask?

Share your reports or simply describe your situation. A specialist reviews your case and you receive
a tailored plan with transparent cost information. The initial assessment costs you nothing.

03Can I speak to a doctor before deciding to travel?

Yes. You can request a written second opinion or a secure video consultation with an Acıbadem
specialist, so you decide with full confidence before booking anything.

04Will I be understood in my own language?

A dedicated multilingual team and professional interpreters support you before, during and after
treatment, so nothing is lost between you and your doctors.

05Are the hospitals and doctors truly world-class?

Care is delivered in JCI-accredited hospitals by physicians recognised internationally in their
fields, using the same advanced technology and protocols you would expect from a leading global
centre.

06What happens after I return home?

Your treatment does not end at discharge. You leave with full medical documentation and a direct
line back to your care team for follow-up questions and ongoing guidance.

## Healthcare for the whole family

At Bass Medical Group we believe in staying connected to our communities. By making your healthcare
accessible when and where you need it we can offer a genuine connection that is personal to you and
those that you love the most.

[Learn About BASS Medical Group][27]
[[A female doctor in a white coat uses a stethoscope on a smiling female patient wearing a striped
shirt in a clinic room.]][28]

## Hand selected for your convenience

With over 200 locations around the San Francisco Bay Area and 100’s of doctors to choose from, you
are sure to find the exact care you need from local professionals hand selected by our dedicated
board of professionals.

[View all locations][29]
[A BASS employee measuring a patient's height]

## Highly trained professionals with compassion

Our well-trained medical professionals work and live among you. They understand the value of our
communities because they are a part of them. Dedicated to bringing a personal touch to healthcare,
they understand the peace of mind that good healthcare brings.

[Doctor directory][30]
[BASS Medical Group's vascular group featuring Dr. Samji, Avise, Orlino, Obnial, and Keyashian.]

## Bringing you tomorrow’s technology today

We believe great care starts with great technology. At BASS Medical Group, we invest in the latest
advancements to give you access to the very best — whether you're here for advanced imaging or
leading-edge cancer treatment.

From our wide-bore MRI and PET/CT scanners at the BASS Imaging Center to precision tools like
MRIdian and AlignRT at the Gregory Rhodes MD Cancer Center, our technology is designed with one goal
in mind: better outcomes, delivered with care.

[Imaging center][31][Cancer center][32]
[Technician adjusting a medical linear accelerator machine labeled Elekta in a clinical treatment
room.]
[BASS Medical Group Logo]

for you and your family.

# A Bioelectronic Medicine Company

# advancing the treatment of autoimmune disease symptoms.

## About Us

Boomerang Medical is on a mission to disrupt the treatment of bowel urgency symptoms in patients
with ulcerative colitis (UC). The company is developing a bioelectric neuromodulation technology,
which has been granted Breakthrough Device Designation by the FDA, currently being evaluated in an
FDA-approved clinical trial studying ulcerative colitis at leading Inflammatory Bowel Disease (IBD)
centers in the US. 

## Our Focus

IBD is one of the most debilitating autoimmune diseases, affecting millions globally. Living with
IBD impacts not just physical health, but also work, relationships, and well-being. Current
treatments include medications and surgery, but the complexity of the condition means that there is
always room for innovative approaches.

What if the next big leap in managing IBD symptoms is already hardwired into our bodies? That's the
question propelling our focus on neuromodulation, a promising frontier in bioelectronic medicine.

##### Boomerang Medical is dedicated to promoting IBD awareness and education. We are proud to be a
##### member of the Crohn’s & Colitis Foundation's Corporate Circle.

Boomerang Medical is headquartered in the heart of Silicon Valley on the campus of El Camino
Hospital in Mountain View, California. We are proud to be a Company–In-Residence at the prestigious
Fogarty Innovation incubator–the only healthcare-focused incubator of its kind in the US–giving us
access to the brightest minds and expertise in the medical technology industry.

[trial-illustration.jpg]

## Does Ulcerative Colitis disrupt your daily life?

Researchers in the BOOM-IBD2 Clinical Trial are exploring whether neuromodulation, a therapy already
approved by the FDA to treat other conditions, can be effective in the treatment of bowel urgency
symptoms in patients with ulcerative colitis.

[Click here to learn more][8]

## Meet the Team

[TomShehab.png]

Chief Executive Officer

Tom Shehab, MD

Tom practiced medicine for 15 years as a gastroenterologist and he brings his experience as a
physician, healthcare executive, and investor focused on medical device and health IT companies to
Boomerang Medical. He serves on the boards of Endogenex, Motif Neurotech, and Virtual Incision, and
previously led Arboretum’s investment in nVision Medical.

 

[Miller D Headshot (2).png]

Co-Founder, Chief Technology Officer

David Miller, MEng

David is an innovator and entrepreneur, holding more than 50 patents spanning diverse technologies
and clinical applications. With over 20 years of experience, David has co-founded multiple
companies, is a Stanford BioDesign Fellow, and was previously a Distinguished Scientist and
Technical Fellow at Medtronic. 

 

[Lucas Headshot.png]

Vice President, Therapy Development

Lucas Payne

Lucas has 20+ years of experience leveraging his passion for patient care, HCP training and
entrepreneurship to advance Class III medical device innovation for companies such as Johnson &
Johnson and Abbott. Lucas began his career in the medical field in patient care as a radiation
technologist.



[bruce-van-deman.png]

Vice President, Clinical & Regulatory

Bruce Van Deman

Bruce is a clinical research and medical sciences executive with extensive experience leading
clinical trials, regulatory strategy, evidence generation and physician engagement across medical
technology companies. He has held senior leadership roles at Medtronic, Edwards Lifesciences,
NeoChord and Conformal Medical, supporting pivotal studies, product development, reimbursement and
commercialization.

[Holthe C Headshot.png]

Senior Director, Clinical Strategy and Safety

Colleen Holthe

Colleen has a deep understanding of clinical research and regulatory affairs within the medical
device industry. She holds 20+ years of experience conducting  25 clinical trials and a proven track
record of leading Class III medical device trials from inception to FDA approval.

[MaleaNEW.png]

Senior Director, Clinical Therapy Development

Malea D'Amico, CCRA, CCRP

Malea has spent 21 years on the front lines of clinical research in over 70 medtech and biotech
clinical trials. An expert in clinical study quality assurance, her experience crosses all phases
clinical trials including benchwork, QA, monitoring, field support and patient outreach.

## Board of Directors + Advisors

Boomerang Medical is proud to be a portfolio company of

[Arboretum Ventures][9] and [Hatteras Venture Partners][10], as well as a

Company-In-Residence at [Fogarty Innovation.][11]

your disease, to what treatment options are available. It’s all here, so you can advocate for a
treatment plan that works for you and help guide your health journey.

**Crohn's** can affect any part of the digestive tract—from the mouth to the anus. On the other
hand, **ulcerative colitis (UC) **is limited to the colon and rectum. Which disease are you
interested in learning more about?

###### Loxoprofen

[Read More][63]
[Beyfortus®]

###### Beyfortus®

A novel drug launched in India to protect newborns and infants from lung infections caused by
Respiratory Syncytial Virus in the first season of exposure.

[Read more][64]
[Colozo®]

###### Colozo®

A USFDA-approved option for Chronic Idiopathic Constipation in adults, which acts on gut receptors
to help support normal digestive function.

[Read more][65]

## Accelerating Access to 
## Affordable and Innovative Medicines
## 
## Our latest launches that bring innovative solutions to patients across the world

[Toripalimab-image]

###### Toripalimab

The first immunotherapy approved by major global regulators for recurrent or metastatic
nasopharyngeal carcinoma (RM-NPC). In India, it introduces immuno-oncology as a first-line treatment
for RM-NPC in combination with chemotherapy.

[Read More][66]
[Bevacizumab-image]

###### Bevacizumab

Our first biosimilar approved and launched in the UK. It is a treatment for several types of cancer,
including colorectal, lung, brain, kidney, cervical, and ovarian cancers. Bevacizumab works by
blocking a protein called VEGF, slowing the growth and spread of cancer.

[Read More][67]
[Lenacapavir-image]

###### Lenacapavir

A long-acting, USFDA-approved treatment for HIV-1 infection. Our work with Lenacapavir supports our
goal to expand HIV treatment and prevention, especially in high-burden regions. We aim to
manufacture and commercialise Lenacapavir across 120 countries, in partnership with Gilead Sciences.

[Read More][68]

## Helping Patients Navigate Their Treatment Journey

[Learn More][69]
[Vega Club]

#### Vega Club

A patient support program where gastroenterologists help people with ulcerative colitis better
understand and manage Inflammatory Bowel Disease through personalised guidance on diet, exercise,
and stress.

[betaCare]

#### betaCare

An initiative in Germany providing useful health information to patients. It also offers certified
online courses to improve patient care, and help them navigate treatment and the healthcare system.

[Joint Health Revolution]

#### Joint Health Revolution

Sessions developed for individuals with osteoarthritis, designed to guide them in understanding
effective joint care. These doctor-led sessions help patients learn about the right exercises,
healthy habits and ways to manage pain, and stay active.

[Learn More][70]

Collaborating to expand access to essential cancer therapies approved for more than 40 types of
cancer, strengthening oncology care and supporting patients with high-burden diseases worldwide.

## From Doing Less Harm to Maximal Good
## 
## We continue working towards reducing our environmental footprint, addressing ecological risks
## from our operations, and are progressing towards carbon neutrality

[Learn More][76]
[Water]

#### Environment

###### Water

By implementing initiatives such as wastewater recovery, grey water use, and more, we reduced
freshwater consumption by ~70,000 KL from April to September 2023.

[Climate Risk Mapping and Scope 3 Reduction image]

###### Climate Risk Mapping and Scope 3 Reduction

By conducting site-level climate risk assessments and improving supplier engagement by sustainable
procurement, we identified key vulnerabilities and reduced Scope 3 emissions intensity by 31% since
FY2023.

[Waste Reduction through Process Efficiency image]

###### Waste Reduction through Process Efficiency

By implementing cost improvement projects and strengthening site-level waste checks, we achieved
20-22% reduction in waste across 9 high-volume products. 

[Decarbonisation Through Renewable Energy image]

###### Decarbonisation Through Renewable Energy

By replacing fossil fuels with biofuels in boilers and expanding solar, wind, and hybrid energy use,
we reduced Scope 1 and 2 emissions by 33% vs FY2023. Energy-saving initiatives also helped avoid
8,073 tonnes of CO₂ and saved 7.75 million kWh in FY2025.

[Learn More][77]

## From Doing Less Harm to Maximal Good
## 
## We continue working towards reducing our environmental footprint, addressing ecological risks
## from our operations, and are progressing towards carbon neutrality

[Learn More][76]
[Water]

#### Environment

###### Water

By implementing initiatives such as wastewater recovery, grey water use, and more, we reduced
freshwater consumption by ~70,000 KL from April to September 2023.

[Climate Risk Mapping and Scope 3 Reduction image]

###### Climate Risk Mapping and Scope 3 Reduction

By conducting site-level climate risk assessments and improving supplier engagement by sustainable
procurement, we identified key vulnerabilities and reduced Scope 3 emissions intensity by 31% since
FY2023.

[Waste Reduction through Process Efficiency image]

###### Waste Reduction through Process Efficiency

By implementing cost improvement projects and strengthening site-level waste checks, we achieved
20-22% reduction in waste across 9 high-volume products. 

[Decarbonisation Through Renewable Energy image]

###### Decarbonisation Through Renewable Energy

By replacing fossil fuels with biofuels in boilers and expanding solar, wind, and hybrid energy use,
we reduced Scope 1 and 2 emissions by 33% vs FY2023. Energy-saving initiatives also helped avoid
8,073 tonnes of CO₂ and saved 7.75 million kWh in FY2025.

Not all policies are created equal, and not all consumers have similar needs.

### Term Life

*Often called “pure insurance” because it’s intended only to protect your dependents in case you die
prematurely.*
* The greatest death benefit for the lowest premium

### No Exam

*It’s a type of coverage that doesn’t require a clinical examination as a part of the underwriting
process.*

to us. We would rather present all options without using high-pressure sales techniques.

reply or a call-back. We make getting [life insurance quotes][143] effortless.

you get the best rates possible, even if you are a high-risk individual.

## Effortlessly Shop for Life Insurance

One might think choosing an insurance broker should be an effortless process. Select the one that
offers you the lowest price, right? Well, that’s certainly not the case. Rather than submitting
applications with eight different carriers, use a broker who has extensive knowledge in dealing with
your distinct health condition to place you with the appropriate carrier with the highest chance for
approval.

### What is life insurance?

You have put great effort into making a living and taking care of your family. Life insurance is a
way to secure that effort even beyond your death.

Life insurance will cover not only funeral and burial costs, but it will also settle your debts, may
off your home, and provide financial stability to your loved ones left behind.

However, purchasing a life insurance plan does take some effort; you will need to research your
options and choose a plan that best fits the needs of your family after your death.

Be sure to get several quotes and compare them so you can make the best decision of your life. 

### How much does life insurance cost?

At time of purchase, life insurance monthly premiums will depend on your age, health, type of
policy, and the amount of insurance desired. The most popular policy sold is a 20-year term policy
worth $500,000, and it has an average monthly premium of $26.

average monthly premiums for a $100,000 policy are regardless of gender or smoking.

  substance-abuse condition that affects every organ system.
  October 28, 2025

  often completed in under 30 seconds. Here, we review a series of ECGs with clinically relevant
  “can’t miss” diagnoses.

## IMPORTANT SAFETY INFORMATION
* **Do not receive ENTYVIO^{®} if you** have had an allergic reaction to ENTYVIO or any of its
  ingredients.
* **ENTYVIO may cause serious side effects, including:**
  * **Infusion-related and serious allergic reactions** can happen while you are receiving ENTYVIO
    or several hours after treatment. You may need treatment if you have an allergic reaction. Tell
    your healthcare provider or get immediate medical help if you get any of these symptoms during
    or after an infusion of ENTYVIO: rash, itching, swelling of your lips, tongue, throat or face,
    shortness of breath or trouble breathing, wheezing, dizziness, feeling hot, or palpitations
    (feel like your heart is racing).
  * **Infections.** ENTYVIO may increase your risk of getting a serious infection. Before and during
    treatment with ENTYVIO, tell your healthcare provider if you think you have an infection or
    symptoms of an infection, such as fever, chills, muscle aches, cough, shortness of breath, runny
    nose, sore throat, red or painful skin or sores on your body, tiredness, or pain during
    urination. If your healthcare provider feels that you are at risk for tuberculosis (TB), you may
    be treated with medicine for TB before you begin treatment with ENTYVIO.
  * **Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML).** People with weakened immune systems can
    get progressive multifocal leukoencephalopathy (PML) (a rare, serious brain infection caused by
    a virus). Although unlikely while receiving ENTYVIO, a risk of PML cannot be ruled out. PML can
    result in death or severe disability. There is no known treatment, prevention, or cure for PML.
    Tell your healthcare provider right away if you have any of the following symptoms: confusion or
    problems thinking, loss of balance, change in the way you walk or talk, decreased strength or
    weakness on one side of the body, blurred vision, or loss of vision.
  * **Liver problems** can happen in people who receive ENTYVIO. Tell your healthcare provider right
    away if you have any of the following symptoms: tiredness, loss of appetite, pain on the right
    side of your abdomen, dark urine, or yellowing of the skin and eyes (jaundice).
* **The most common side effects of ENTYVIO include:** common cold, headache, joint pain, nausea,
  fever, infections of the nose and throat, tiredness, cough, bronchitis, flu, back pain, rash,
  itching, sinus infection, throat pain, pain in extremities, and with injections under the skin:
  pain, swelling, itching, hives, bruising, rash, or redness at the injection site. These are not
  all the possible side effects of ENTYVIO. Call your healthcare provider for medical advice about
  side effects.
* **Before receiving ENTYVIO, tell your healthcare provider about all of your medical conditions,
  including if you:** have or think you may have an infection or have infections that keep coming
  back; have liver problems; have TB or have been in close contact with someone with TB; have
  recently received or are scheduled to receive a vaccine; or if you are pregnant, breastfeeding,
  plan to become pregnant, or plan to breastfeed.
* **Tell your healthcare provider about all the medicines you take, especially if you take or have
  recently taken** Tysabri (natalizumab), Tyruko (natalizumab-sztn), a Tumor Necrosis Factor (TNF)
  blocker medicine, a medicine that weakens your immune system (immunosuppressant), or
  corticosteroid medicine.

**Please see accompanying [full Prescribing Information][29], including the [Medication Guide][30],
for ENTYVIO and talk with your healthcare provider.**

**ENTYVIO is available for:**
* **intravenous (IV) infusion: 300 mg vedolizumab.**
* **subcutaneous (SC) injection: 108 mg vedolizumab.**

You are encouraged to report negative side effects of prescription drugs to the FDA.
Visit [www.fda.gov/medwatch][31] or call 1-800-FDA-1088[1-800-FDA-1088][32].

ENTYVIO is a prescription medicine used in adults for the treatment of:
* moderately to severely active ulcerative colitis (UC).
* moderately to severely active Crohn’s disease (CD).

It is not known if ENTYVIO is safe and effective in children under 18 years of age.

## IMPORTANT SAFETY INFORMATION
* **Do not receive ENTYVIO^{®} if you** have had an allergic reaction to ENTYVIO or any of its
  ingredients.
* **ENTYVIO may cause serious side effects, including:**
  * **Infusion-related and serious allergic reactions** can happen while you are receiving ENTYVIO
    or several hours after treatment. You may need treatment if you have an allergic reaction. Tell
    your healthcare provider or get immediate medical help if you get any of these symptoms during
    or after an infusion of ENTYVIO: rash, itching, swelling of your lips, tongue, throat or face,
    shortness of breath or trouble breathing, wheezing, dizziness, feeling hot, or palpitations
    (feel like your heart is racing).
  * **Infections.** ENTYVIO may increase your risk of getting a serious infection. Before and during
    treatment with ENTYVIO, tell your healthcare provider if you think you have an infection or
    symptoms of an infection, such as fever, chills, muscle aches, cough, shortness of breath, runny
    nose, sore throat, red or painful skin or sores on your body, tiredness, or pain during
    urination. If your healthcare provider feels that you are at risk for tuberculosis (TB), you may
    be treated with medicine for TB before you begin treatment with ENTYVIO.
  * **Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML).** People with weakened immune systems can
    get progressive multifocal leukoencephalopathy (PML) (a rare, serious brain infection caused by
    a virus). Although unlikely while receiving ENTYVIO, a risk of PML cannot be ruled out. PML can
    result in death or severe disability. There is no known treatment, prevention, or cure for PML.
    Tell your healthcare provider right away if you have any of the following symptoms: confusion or
    problems thinking, loss of balance, change in the way you walk or talk, decreased strength or
    weakness on one side of the body, blurred vision, or loss of vision.
  * **Liver problems** can happen in people who receive ENTYVIO. Tell your healthcare provider right
    away if you have any of the following symptoms: tiredness, loss of appetite, pain on the right
    side of your abdomen, dark urine, or yellowing of the skin and eyes (jaundice).
* **The most common side effects of ENTYVIO include:** common cold, headache, joint pain, nausea,
  fever, infections of the nose and throat, tiredness, cough, bronchitis, flu, back pain, rash,
  itching, sinus infection, throat pain, pain in extremities, and with injections under the skin:
  pain, swelling, itching, hives, bruising, rash, or redness at the injection site. These are not
  all the possible side effects of ENTYVIO. Call your healthcare provider for medical advice about
  side effects.
* **Before receiving ENTYVIO, tell your healthcare provider about all of your medical conditions,
  including if you:** have or think you may have an infection or have infections that keep coming
  back; have liver problems; have TB or have been in close contact with someone with TB; have
  recently received or are scheduled to receive a vaccine; or if you are pregnant, breastfeeding,
  plan to become pregnant, or plan to breastfeed.
* **Tell your healthcare provider about all the medicines you take, especially if you take or have
  recently taken** Tysabri (natalizumab), Tyruko (natalizumab-sztn), a Tumor Necrosis Factor (TNF)
  blocker medicine, a medicine that weakens your immune system (immunosuppressant), or
  corticosteroid medicine.

**Please see accompanying [full Prescribing Information][29], including the [Medication Guide][30],
for ENTYVIO and talk with your healthcare provider.**

**ENTYVIO is available for:**
* **intravenous (IV) infusion: 300 mg vedolizumab.**
* **subcutaneous (SC) injection: 108 mg vedolizumab.**

You are encouraged to report negative side effects of prescription drugs to the FDA.
Visit [www.fda.gov/medwatch][31] or call 1-800-FDA-1088[1-800-FDA-1088][32].

### What is ENTYVIO (vedolizumab)?

ENTYVIO is a prescription medicine used in adults for the treatment of:
* moderately to severely active ulcerative colitis (UC).
* moderately to severely active Crohn’s disease (CD).

It is not known if ENTYVIO is safe and effective in children under 18 years of age.

#### IMPORTANT SAFETY INFORMATION

##### CONTRAINDICATIONS

ENTYVIO is contraindicated in patients who have had a known serious or severe hypersensitivity
reaction to ENTYVIO or any of its excipients.

##### WARNINGS AND PRECAUTIONS
* **Infusion-Related and Hypersensitivity Reactions: **Infusion-related reactions and
  hypersensitivity reactions, including anaphylaxis, dyspnea, bronchospasm, urticaria, flushing,
  rash, and increased blood pressure and heart rate, have been reported. These reactions may occur
  with the first or subsequent infusions and may vary in their time of onset from during infusion or
  up to several hours post-infusion. If anaphylaxis or other serious infusion-related or
  hypersensitivity reactions occur, discontinue administration of ENTYVIO immediately and initiate
  appropriate treatment.
* **Infections: **ENTYVIO increases the risk for developing infections. Serious infections in
  clinical trials included anal abscess, sepsis (some fatal), tuberculosis (TB), salmonella sepsis,
  Listeria meningitis, giardiasis, and cytomegaloviral colitis. Postmarketing reports include

MAdCAM-1, which is mainly expressed on the gut endothelial cells.¹

**Lasting relief and CS-free remission** at Week 52^{1‡}

###### Welcome to Evologics

# Committed.

***Evologics***  is a surgical biologics distributor focused on human tissue allografts and related
products. We work with physicians, hospitals, and surgical centers to provide access to products for
surgical applications consistent with their official labeling and regulatory status.

***Evologics*** is proud to partner with industry leaders that have created and practice only the
highest bone and tissue sterilization processes. Using processes like PASCO2^{®}, our products are
sterilized while preserving biologic integrity, ensuring only high-quality bone, tissue and
allografts.

[ DOWNLOAD CATALOG ][68]

###### Our Values

## Safety, innovation and service.

###### 01.

##### Safety

Guided by our core values of accountability, precision, and transparency, we foster a culture where
safety is everyone’s priority. We are committed to protecting the health and well-being of patients,
partners, and communities by ensuring the highest standards of safety across every aspect of our
operations.

###### 02.

##### Innovation

We make lives better by combining our product innovations with compassion, ensuring healthcare
providers receive only the best products for their patients. By embracing cutting-edge technology
and creativity, we aim to improve patient outcomes, and create new standards in safety and standard
of care.

###### 03.

##### Service

We deliver exceptional service that consistently exceeds expectations, forging long-lasting, strong
relationships with our partners. We are dedicated to fostering trust, reliability, collaboration and
responsiveness with every interaction, empowering healthcare providers while improving patient
outcomes.

###### Our Products

## Committed to Quality

Evologics offers a wide array of products, including amnion, soft tissue allografts, bone and more
for a wide array of specialties, including spine, orthopedics, sports medicine, ophthalmology,
cosmetic surgery, podiatry and wound care.

##### EvoPatch Amnion

Minimally Manipulated Amniotic Tissue that can be used in open incision, laparoscopy and/or robotic
surgery procedures

##### Demineralized Bone Matrix

Available in multiple sizes to address a a wide array of procedures, including foot and ankle,
trauma and extremities, knees, hips, craniomaxillofacial, spine and more.

##### DBM Fiber

Demineralized cortical bone fibers that are entangled and shaped into sizes engineered to complement
specific surgical applications.

##### Bone and Tendon Allografts

Hard and soft allografts in a variety of configurations for most surgical applications.

###### Our Purpose

*“At Evologics, we understand successful business depends on a successful team. With the perfect
team, we continue to strive for excellence, providing healthcare professionals with products that
make people live better, healthier lives. We care more – and that’s what makes the difference.”*

Michael Crescenzo

longer, healthier lives.

Guided by our core values of accountability, precision, and transparency, we foster a culture where
safety is everyone’s priority. We are committed to protecting the health and well-being of patients,
partners, and communities by ensuring the highest standards of safety across every aspect of our
operations.

###### 02.

##### Innovation

We make lives better by combining our product innovations with compassion, ensuring healthcare
providers receive only the best products for their patients. By embracing cutting-edge technology
and creativity, we aim to improve patient outcomes, and create new standards in safety and standard
of care.

###### 03.

##### Service

We deliver exceptional service that consistently exceeds expectations, forging long-lasting, strong
relationships with our partners. We are dedicated to fostering trust, reliability, collaboration and
responsiveness with every interaction, empowering healthcare providers while improving patient
outcomes.

###### Our Products

## Committed to Quality

Evologics offers a wide array of products, including amnion, soft tissue allografts, bone and more
for a wide array of specialties, including spine, orthopedics, sports medicine, ophthalmology,
cosmetic surgery, podiatry and wound care.

##### EvoPatch Amnion

Minimally Manipulated Amniotic Tissue that can be used in open incision, laparoscopy and/or robotic
surgery procedures

##### Demineralized Bone Matrix

Available in multiple sizes to address a a wide array of procedures, including foot and ankle,
trauma and extremities, knees, hips, craniomaxillofacial, spine and more.

##### DBM Fiber

Demineralized cortical bone fibers that are entangled and shaped into sizes engineered to complement
specific surgical applications.

##### Bone and Tendon Allografts

Hard and soft allografts in a variety of configurations for most surgical applications.

###### Our Purpose

*“At Evologics, we understand successful business depends on a successful team. With the perfect
team, we continue to strive for excellence, providing healthcare professionals with products that
make people live better, healthier lives. We care more – and that’s what makes the difference.”*

Michael Crescenzo

precise, personal, and connected - and build integrated solutions to help solve for the industry's
greatest challenges to enable better outcomes and improve the lives of patients and clinicians. With

empowering clinicians to make therapies more accurate and effective.

## GI Specialists of Georgia Gastroenterologists

Colon (large intestine) health is an area of a person’s health too often ignored. Colon cancer is
among the chief causes of cancer death in men and women every year. At least half of those deaths
could be prevented with regular colon cancer screenings or colonoscopies. When you need to schedule
a colonoscopy in the Douglasville or Atlanta area, it can be overwhelming knowing where to turn.
Established in 2007, GI Specialists of Georgia is a leading gastroenterology practice with
nine [office locations][80] and three [endoscopy centers][81] in Northwest Atlanta.

[Our board-certified gastroenterologists][82] diagnose and treat many gastroenterology diseases and
disorders involving the digestive tract, intestines, liver, stomach, gallbladder, and pancreas. We
specialize in a variety of treatments, including colonoscopies, fibroscans, ultrasounds, pathology
lab services, and anesthesia for many general and advanced gastrointestinal procedures. Patients
visit us for treatment of anything from acid reflux or irritable bowel syndrome (IBS) to
hemorrhoids, hepatitis C, pancreatitis, and other gastrointestinal infections.

[
Meet Our Staff
][83]
[A patient checking out at the front desk of GI Specialists of Georgia, located in Atlanta, GA]

## Why Choose GI Specialists of Georgia for GI Procedures?

Formed as the result of a merger between Digestive Care Associates and Northwest Gastroenterology
Associates, GI Specialists of Georgia strives to be a top medical practice. Patients choose us for
many reasons, including:
* **Individualized Treatment Plans**– Our gastroenterologists create personalized treatment plans
  for every patient using evidence-based medicine and cutting-edge advances. Giving our patients
  access to [online forms][84] and bill pay are two of the ways we strive to make our patient care
  convenient.
* **Friendly, Collaborative Environment **– Our on-staff gastroenterologists have many skillsets in
  sub-specialty areas of gastroenterology to provide the latest treatments and manage cases with a
  higher level of complexity. However, we also work in a friendly, collaborative environment to
  coordinate care with every patient’s primary care physician.
* **Patient Feedback Welcome **– We monitor our services closely and utilize patient feedback via
  daily patient survey requests delivered through our [patient portal][85]. This allows us to update
  our processes to improve the patient experience.

[
View Our Services
][86]
[A patient and doctor discussing colonoscopy benefits at GI Specialists of Georgia.]

## How a Colonoscopy at Our Offices Could Save Your Life

Colonoscopies check for many health issues, most notably colon tumors and polyps. Whether you have a
family history of colon cancer or not, you should plan on getting a checkup if you’re over the age
of 45. As with any other form of cancer, the earlier you’re diagnosed with colon cancer, the better
your chances of beating it with treatment are. Are you wondering what colon cancer pain feels like
and how you’d be able to tell if you had it? Symptoms of colon cancer will vary by patient but may
include abdominal pains, blood in the stool, unexplained weight loss, weakness or fatigue, and
changes in your bowel movements, such as frequent diarrhea or constipation. Many people with colon
cancer won’t exhibit any symptoms during the early stages. You should measure colonoscopy costs in
terms of the value of your health. If you need to schedule a colonoscopy in the Douglasville or
Atlanta area, don’t delay. Schedule a screening with the gastroenterologists at GI Specialists of
Georgia. Learn more about how early detection through a [colon cancer screening could save your
life][87].

## GI Specialists of Georgia Gastroenterologists

Colon (large intestine) health is an area of a person’s health too often ignored. Colon cancer is
among the chief causes of cancer death in men and women every year. At least half of those deaths
could be prevented with regular colon cancer screenings or colonoscopies. When you need to schedule
a colonoscopy in the Douglasville or Atlanta area, it can be overwhelming knowing where to turn.
Established in 2007, GI Specialists of Georgia is a leading gastroenterology practice with
nine [office locations][80] and three [endoscopy centers][81] in Northwest Atlanta.

[Our board-certified gastroenterologists][82] diagnose and treat many gastroenterology diseases and
disorders involving the digestive tract, intestines, liver, stomach, gallbladder, and pancreas. We
specialize in a variety of treatments, including colonoscopies, fibroscans, ultrasounds, pathology
lab services, and anesthesia for many general and advanced gastrointestinal procedures. Patients
visit us for treatment of anything from acid reflux or irritable bowel syndrome (IBS) to
hemorrhoids, hepatitis C, pancreatitis, and other gastrointestinal infections.

[
Meet Our Staff
][83]
[A patient checking out at the front desk of GI Specialists of Georgia, located in Atlanta, GA]

## Why Choose GI Specialists of Georgia for GI Procedures?

Formed as the result of a merger between Digestive Care Associates and Northwest Gastroenterology
Associates, GI Specialists of Georgia strives to be a top medical practice. Patients choose us for
many reasons, including:
* **Individualized Treatment Plans**– Our gastroenterologists create personalized treatment plans
  for every patient using evidence-based medicine and cutting-edge advances. Giving our patients
  access to [online forms][84] and bill pay are two of the ways we strive to make our patient care
  convenient.
* **Friendly, Collaborative Environment **– Our on-staff gastroenterologists have many skillsets in
  sub-specialty areas of gastroenterology to provide the latest treatments and manage cases with a
  higher level of complexity. However, we also work in a friendly, collaborative environment to
  coordinate care with every patient’s primary care physician.
* **Patient Feedback Welcome **– We monitor our services closely and utilize patient feedback via
  daily patient survey requests delivered through our [patient portal][85]. This allows us to update
  our processes to improve the patient experience.

[
View Our Services
][86]
[A patient and doctor discussing colonoscopy benefits at GI Specialists of Georgia.]

## How a Colonoscopy at Our Offices Could Save Your Life

Colonoscopies check for many health issues, most notably colon tumors and polyps. Whether you have a
family history of colon cancer or not, you should plan on getting a checkup if you’re over the age
of 45. As with any other form of cancer, the earlier you’re diagnosed with colon cancer, the better
your chances of beating it with treatment are. Are you wondering what colon cancer pain feels like
and how you’d be able to tell if you had it? Symptoms of colon cancer will vary by patient but may
include abdominal pains, blood in the stool, unexplained weight loss, weakness or fatigue, and
changes in your bowel movements, such as frequent diarrhea or constipation. Many people with colon
cancer won’t exhibit any symptoms during the early stages. You should measure colonoscopy costs in
terms of the value of your health. If you need to schedule a colonoscopy in the Douglasville or
Atlanta area, don’t delay. Schedule a screening with the gastroenterologists at GI Specialists of
Georgia. Learn more about how early detection through a [colon cancer screening could save your
life][87].

### About Gastrointestinal Specialists of Long Island

Gastrointestinal Specialists of Long Island (GISLI) is a state-of-the-art gastroenterology practice
providing comprehensive digestive and liver care to all adults throughout Long Island. With two
convenient offices in Wantagh and Malverne, New York, Drs. Novak and Marwil provide patients with
unparalleled preventive care, advanced diagnostics, and effective treatments.

The gastroenterologists at GISLI offer patients more than 30 years of experience. They’ve created a
premier endoscopy center that ensures patients receive comfortable, personalized care. The practice
offers upper endoscopy, [colonoscopy][37], and office-based capsule endoscopy to view the entire
small bowel. Breath testing is also available to evaluate for small intestinal bacterial overgrowth,
lactose intolerance, fructose intolerance, and sucrose intolerance.

GISLI strives to offer a safe haven to patients who might otherwise feel uncomfortable or
discouraged from seeking treatment for [rectal bleeding][38], [constipation][39], inflammatory bowel
disease, and other digestive disorders. They take pride in providing patients with empathetic care.
Each physician ensures their patients receive the one-on-one treatment they deserve.

Call Gastrointestinal Specialists of Long Island today or go online to schedule an appointment with
a gastroenterologist.

### About Gastrointestinal Specialists of Long Island

Gastrointestinal Specialists of Long Island (GISLI) is a state-of-the-art gastroenterology practice
providing comprehensive digestive and liver care to all adults throughout Long Island. With two
convenient offices in Wantagh and Malverne, New York, Drs. Novak and Marwil provide patients with
unparalleled preventive care, advanced diagnostics, and effective treatments.

The gastroenterologists at GISLI offer patients more than 30 years of experience. They’ve created a
premier endoscopy center that ensures patients receive comfortable, personalized care. The practice
offers upper endoscopy, [colonoscopy][37], and office-based capsule endoscopy to view the entire
small bowel. Breath testing is also available to evaluate for small intestinal bacterial overgrowth,
lactose intolerance, fructose intolerance, and sucrose intolerance.

GISLI strives to offer a safe haven to patients who might otherwise feel uncomfortable or
discouraged from seeking treatment for [rectal bleeding][38], [constipation][39], inflammatory bowel
disease, and other digestive disorders. They take pride in providing patients with empathetic care.
Each physician ensures their patients receive the one-on-one treatment they deserve.

Call Gastrointestinal Specialists of Long Island today or go online to schedule an appointment with
a gastroenterologist.

### About Gastrointestinal Specialists of Long Island

Gastrointestinal Specialists of Long Island (GISLI) is a state-of-the-art gastroenterology practice
providing comprehensive digestive and liver care to all adults throughout Long Island. With two
convenient offices in Wantagh and Malverne, New York, Drs. Novak and Marwil provide patients with
unparalleled preventive care, advanced diagnostics, and effective treatments.

The gastroenterologists at GISLI offer patients more than 30 years of experience. They’ve created a
premier endoscopy center that ensures patients receive comfortable, personalized care. The practice
offers upper endoscopy, [colonoscopy][37], and office-based capsule endoscopy to view the entire
small bowel. Breath testing is also available to evaluate for small intestinal bacterial overgrowth,
lactose intolerance, fructose intolerance, and sucrose intolerance.

GISLI strives to offer a safe haven to patients who might otherwise feel uncomfortable or
discouraged from seeking treatment for [rectal bleeding][38], [constipation][39], inflammatory bowel
disease, and other digestive disorders. They take pride in providing patients with empathetic care.
Each physician ensures their patients receive the one-on-one treatment they deserve.

Call Gastrointestinal Specialists of Long Island today or go online to schedule an appointment with
a gastroenterologist.

## Global Market Transformation

In a recent feature published by ODT Magazine, Husnu Ceylan shared his perspective on the
transformation of the global orthobiologics market and the increasingly strategic role these
solutions play in modern orthopedic care. During the interview, Ceylan highlighted that market
growth is being driven by a convergence of demographic, clinical, and structural factors, but most
importantly by a shift in surgical thinking. Today, surgeons are not only focused on mechanical
stabilization, but are increasingly seeking biological solutions that enhance healing, improve
functional outcomes, and deliver greater long-term clinical predictability. As Ceylan noted, the
growth of orthobiologics is not simply about increasing procedure volumes, but about the evolution
of surgical care itself, where biology is becoming an essential component of standard orthopedic and
spine treatment. The feature also underscores how orthobiologics have evolved beyond a niche segment
to become increasingly integrated across spine, trauma, sports medicine, and complex reconstruction
procedures, reinforcing their role as one of the fastest-evolving areas in musculoskeletal care.
Read the full article here: Au Naturel: How Orthobiologics Are Reshaping Care

transformation of the global orthobiologics market and the increasingly strategic role these
solutions play in modern orthopedic care. During the interview, Ceylan highlighted that market
growth is being driven by a convergence of demographic, clinical, and structural factors, but most
importantly by a shift in surgical thinking. Today, surgeons are not only focused on mechanical
stabilization, but are increasingly seeking biological solutions that enhance healing, improve
functional outcomes, and deliver greater long-term clinical predictability. As Ceylan noted, the
growth of orthobiologics is not simply about increasing procedure volumes, but about the evolution
of surgical care itself, where biology is becoming an essential component of standard orthopedic and
spine treatment. The feature also underscores how orthobiologics have evolved beyond a niche segment
to become increasingly integrated across spine, trauma, sports medicine, and complex reconstruction
procedures, reinforcing their role as one of the fastest-evolving areas in musculoskeletal care.

# Optimizing Health Since 1984

[
[TrueNorth Entrance]
][39]

## Welcome

Founded in 1984 by Drs. Alan Goldhamer and Jennifer Marano, TrueNorth Health Center in scenic Sonoma
County, California, is now the world’s largest facility specializing in medically supervised
water-only fasting, which can provide a foundation for optimum health.

[
[Rich Roll Video]
][40]

Watch Dr. Alan Goldhamer on the Rich Roll Podcast

## Meet Our Founder

Dr. Alan Goldhamer is one of the world’s preeminent experts on water-only fasting. He is also
founder of the TrueNorth Health Foundation, a nonprofit organization dedicated to expanding
evidence-based knowledge of how medically supervised, water-only fasting and an exclusively
whole-plant-food diet impact human health.

[Learn More][41]

## About Water-Only Fasting

[Raindrop]

### Advantages

Under the right conditions, fasting can trigger health benefits that can be difficult to otherwise
achieve.

[Clock]

### Duration

Every case is unique. We will work with you to determine your optimal fast length.

[Meditation]

### About Your Fast

We will help you begin and end your fast with exclusively whole-plant foods in our
medically-supervised, deeply restful environment.

[Learn More][42]
[Woman holding fasting book]

## Now Available!

Following on the success of our last book, *The Pleasure Trap*, our new book *Can Fasting Save Your
Life?* takes a deep dive into the clinical research that supports the many benefits of water-only
fasting.

[Learn More][43]

Join our email list for updates about TrueNorth Health Center.

# Optimizing Health Since 1984

[
[TrueNorth Entrance]
][39]

## Welcome

Founded in 1984 by Drs. Alan Goldhamer and Jennifer Marano, TrueNorth Health Center in scenic Sonoma
County, California, is now the world’s largest facility specializing in medically supervised
water-only fasting, which can provide a foundation for optimum health.

[
[Rich Roll Video]
][40]

Watch Dr. Alan Goldhamer on the Rich Roll Podcast

## Meet Our Founder

Dr. Alan Goldhamer is one of the world’s preeminent experts on water-only fasting. He is also
founder of the TrueNorth Health Foundation, a nonprofit organization dedicated to expanding
evidence-based knowledge of how medically supervised, water-only fasting and an exclusively
whole-plant-food diet impact human health.

[Learn More][41]

## About Water-Only Fasting

[Raindrop]

### Advantages

Under the right conditions, fasting can trigger health benefits that can be difficult to otherwise
achieve.

[Clock]

### Duration

Every case is unique. We will work with you to determine your optimal fast length.

[Meditation]

### About Your Fast

We will help you begin and end your fast with exclusively whole-plant foods in our
medically-supervised, deeply restful environment.

[Learn More][42]
[Woman holding fasting book]

## Now Available!

Following on the success of our last book, *The Pleasure Trap*, our new book *Can Fasting Save Your
Life?* takes a deep dive into the clinical research that supports the many benefits of water-only
fasting.

[Learn More][43]

### IMPORTANT SAFETY INFORMATION 
### ABOUT HUMIRA^{®} (adalimumab)¹

### **What is the most important information I should know about HUMIRA?**

You should discuss the potential benefits and risks of HUMIRA with your doctor. HUMIRA is a TNF
blocker medicine that can lower the ability of your immune system to fight infections. You should
not start taking HUMIRA if you have any kind of infection unless your doctor says it is okay.
* **Serious infections have happened in people taking HUMIRA. These serious infections include
  tuberculosis (TB) and infections caused by viruses, fungi, or bacteria that have spread throughout
  the body. Some people have died from these infections.** Your doctor should test you for TB before
  starting HUMIRA, and check you closely for signs and symptoms of TB during treatment with HUMIRA,
  even if your TB test was negative. If your doctor feels you are at risk, you may be treated with
  medicine for TB.
* **Cancer.** For children and adults taking TNF blockers, including HUMIRA, the chance of getting
  lymphoma or other cancers may increase. There have been cases of unusual cancers in children,
  teenagers, and young adults using TNF blockers. Some people have developed a rare type of cancer
  called hepatosplenic T-cell lymphoma. This type of cancer often results in death. If using TNF
  blockers including HUMIRA, your chance of getting two types of skin cancer (basal cell and
  squamous cell) may increase. These types are generally not life-threatening if treated; tell your
  doctor if you have a bump or open sore that doesn’t heal.

### **What should I tell my doctor BEFORE starting HUMIRA?**

**Tell your doctor about all of your health conditions**, including if you:
* Have an infection, are being treated for infection, or have symptoms of an infection
* Get a lot of infections or infections that keep coming back
* Have diabetes
* Have TB or have been in close contact with someone with TB, or were born in, lived in, or traveled
  where there is more risk for getting TB
* Live or have lived in an area (such as the Ohio and Mississippi River valleys) where there is an
  increased risk for getting certain kinds of fungal infections, such as histoplasmosis,
  coccidioidomycosis, or blastomycosis. These infections may happen or become more severe if you use
  HUMIRA. Ask your doctor if you are unsure if you have lived in these areas
* Have or have had hepatitis B
* Are scheduled for major surgery
* Have or have had cancer
* Have numbness or tingling or a nervous system disease suc

**K****aizen Gastro Care** is one of the **trusted gastroenterology clinics in Wakad, Pune**,
offering expert care for digestive health problems. The clinic was founded in 2022 by **Dr. Vikrant
Kale** (Senior Gastroenterologist, Hepatologist & Interventional Endoscopist) and **Dr. Samrat
Jankar** (Senior Gastroenterologist, Laparoscopic & GI Surgeon) with the aim of providing
high-quality gastrointestinal care in PCMC, Pune. Kaizen Gastro Care provides full-time availability
of experienced gastroenterologists, helping patients get the right diagnosis and treatment for
digestive diseases. The center was established with a vision to provide advanced and comprehensive
gastrointestinal care under one roof. Dr. Vikrant Kale has **18 years of experience** and has
performed more than **6000 gastroscopies, 4000 colonoscopies, and 2000 ERCP procedures**. Dr. Samrat
Jankar has **17 years of experience** and has performed more than **3000+ successful [laparoscopic
surgeries][130]** and **5,000+ successful Anal Fistula Surgeries**

digestive system, liver, pancreas, **[gallbladder][131]**, and intestines. We provide treatment for
conditions such as **[acidity][132]**, abdominal pain, liver diseases, **[piles][133]**, fissure,
[**fistula**][134], **[IBS][135]**, [**IBD**][136], gallstones, and other complex gastrointestinal
problems. If you are searching for the best **stomach doctor in Pune** or a gastroenterologist near
you, Kaizen Gastro Care offers expert treatment with a patient-focused approach. Early diagnosis and
timely treatment can help prevent complications and ensure faster recovery.

## Compassionate & Advanced IBD Care

Kaizen IBD Care is the first fully dedicated IBD Treatment Center in Pune that provides
evidence-based treatment to all kinds of your IBD problems.

[ Book Your Appointment ][37]
[ Call Us Now! ][38]
[Kaizen IBD Care About]

##### Dedicated IBD Care

Comfortable and efficient treatment in a caring environment.

##### Hassle-Free Booking

Schedule your visit with just a simple booking form.

##### Clinic Hours

Mon – Sat: 09:00 AM – 02:00 PM | 05:00 PM – 09:00 PM

[Kaizen IBD Care - Dedicated IBD Treatment Center in Pune]

Kaizen IBD Care is a dedicated IBD clinic in Wakad, Pune specializing in the diagnosis, treatment,
and long-term management of Inflammatory Bowel Disease (IBD) including Ulcerative Colitis and
Crohn’s Disease. The clinic provides comprehensive IBD care through a combined medical and surgical
approach led by an experienced IBD Specialist and Colorectal Surgeon. The clinic is led by Dr.
Vikrant Kale, IBD Specialist and Senior Gastroenterologist, and Dr. Samrat Jankar, Colorectal
Surgeon and IBD Surgeon, who provide advanced treatment for complex IBD conditions and colorectal
diseases.

Kaizen IBD Care is one of the few dedicated IBD centers in Pune, providing specialized care for
patients suffering from chronic diarrhea, blood in stool, abdominal pain, weight loss, ulcerative
colitis, Crohn’s disease, and intestinal inflammation. The clinic is located in Wakad, Pune, and
patients visit from Hinjewadi, Baner, Balewadi, Aundh, Pimple Saudagar, Pimpri-Chinchwad, Ravet,
Nigdi, and nearby areas for specialized IBD treatment.

[ Read More ][39]

#### IBD Services We Provide

[Ulcerative Colitis Treatment in Pune by Kaizen IBD Care]

##### Ulcerative Colitis

Ulcerative Colitis is a type of Inflammatory Bowel Disease (IBD) that mainly affects the inner
lining of the colon and rectum.

[ Read More... ][40]
[Crohn’s Disease Treatment in Pune, India at Kaizen IBD Care]

##### Crohn’s Disease

Crohn’s Disease is an autoimmune condition where the body’s immune system mistakenly attacks the
digestive tract.

[ Read More... ][41]
[Expert Indeterminate Colitis Treatment in Pune, India at Kaizen IBD Care]

##### Indeterminate Colitis

Indeterminate Colitis is diagnosed when inflammation of the colon cannot be clearly labelled as
Ulcerative Colitis or Crohn’s Disease.

[ Read More... ][42]
[Perianal Crohn’s Disease Treatment in Pune by Kaizen IBD Care]

##### Perianal Crohn’s Disease

Perianal Crohn’s Disease occurs when Crohn’s Disease causes inflammation around the anus

[ Read More... ][43]

#### Our IBD Experts

This combined medical and surgical approach provides complete IBD care under one center.

[Dr. Vikrant Kale - Gastroenterologist & IBD Specialist in Pune at Kaizen IBD Care]

##### Dr. Vikrant Kale (IBD Specialist & Senior Gastroenterologist)

With over 17 years of experience, Dr. Kale is a highly respected IBD specialist in Pune. He
completed his Fellowship in Inflammatory Bowel Disease from Oxford University (UK) in 2018. His
expertise in advanced biological therapies and interventional endoscopy ensures that patients
receive the latest global standards of medical care.

[Dr. Samrat Jankar - Surgical Gastroenterologist & IBD Surgeon in Pune at Kaizen IBD Care]

##### Dr. Samrat Jankar (Colorectal Surgeon & IBD Surgeon)

A leading Surgical Gastroenterologist, Dr. Jankar specialises in minimally invasive and Robotic
Surgeries for IBD complications. His expertise in managing complex fistulas, strictures, and pouch
surgeries provides a vital safety net for patients who require surgical intervention.

# We produce useful and usable guidance for the NHS and wider health and care system.

Our recommendations help practitioners and commissioners get the best care to people, fast, while
ensuring value for the taxpayer.

[Find guidance][11]

## Latest from NICE

### [New draft PMOS guideline recommends annual review and could mean quicker diagnosis][12]

People with polyendocrine metabolic ovarian syndrome (PMOS) should have their condition diagnosed
sooner and be offered an annual review to monitor symptoms, treatment and long-term health risks,
according to our draft guideline published for public consultation today.

News01 July 2026
1. ### [New technologies could help cut years-long wait for endometriosis diagnosis, says NICE][13]
   
   Two new non-invasive diagnostic technologies can be used in the NHS while further evidence is
   generated to speed up the diagnosis of endometriosis in primary care.
   
   News07 July 2026
2. ### [From hospital to home][14]
   
   Hear from Leslie, a heart failure patient, his wife and carer Anne, and his consultant Dr Andrew
   Flett and discover how a NICE-recommended sensor the size of a paperclip is transforming heart
   failure care. Evidence from 3 randomised controlled trials shows it reduces hospitalisations by
   34%.
   
   In-depth29 June 2026
3. ### [New treatment option recommended for recurrent or metastatic cervical cancer][15]
   
   A new treatment option is now available on the NHS for cervical cancer that has come back or
   spread to other parts of the body, following our final draft guidance published today.
   
   News24 June 2026

[View all news, blogs and podcasts][16]

## Backing the healthtech that changes lives

Ammaarah spent years just surviving with type 1 diabetes.
Now she's thriving, with hybrid closed loop technology managing her insulin.

[Developing or adopting healthtech? Learn more][17]

## Implementation and planning

Best practice resources for practitioners and commissioners.

[Quality improvement - using our standards and indicators][18]

Helping you define, improve and measure quality in health, public health and social care.

[Guidelines and resources for social care][19]

Resources and recommendations for adult and children’s social care, with example scenarios to help
put them into practice.

[Productivity, planning and cost saving resources][20]

Explore ways to plan, save money and make decisions on the best ways to use resources.

## More ways we support you

Useful sources of information and advice for healthcare professionals, patients, parents and carers.

[Advice and information on the use of drugs][21]

The British National Formulary (BNF) provides information about the selection, prescribing,
dispensing and administration of drugs.

[Summaries of evidence and advice on common health topics ][22]

With over 370 topics to choose from, clinical knowledge summaries (CKS) can provide quick answers to
clinical questions.

[Making decisions about your care][23]

Our patient decision aids (PDAs) include treatment options available, likely outcomes, benefits,
harms and uncertainties.

## Modular updates window now open

Modular updates focus on reviewing specific methods or processes used to develop NICE guidance.
Submit your ideas and suggestions from Monday 15 June to Sunday 16 August.

[Learn more about modular updates][24]

## How NICE's independent committees help us develop our recommendations

Debra Quantrill was 38 when she had a life-changing heart attack. Now she’s working as a patient
representative on one of NICE’s independent committees. Find out how you can [join a NICE
independent committee][25] and make a real difference to patient care.

  papers and a water bottle.]
  
  ### [From patient to changemaker: how one mother's experience is shaping healthcare for
  ### thousands][26]
  
  In-depth

  her. A large plant is in the background.]

# Pioneers in Immunoregulatory Drug Discovery and Development

We develop novel immunoregulatory therapeutics for patients with autoimmune diseases, starting with
ulcerative colitis and Crohn’s disease.

[Find out how][12]

# Our Mission

We are a late-clinical-stage precision inflammation and immunology (I&I) biopharmaceutical company
focused on the development of the next wave of first- and best-in-class biomarker-driven
immunoregulatory therapeutics. Our lead clinical candidate, omilancor, is a Phase 3, first-in-class,
oral, gut-restricted LANCL2 therapeutic for ulcerative colitis (UC) and Crohn’s disease (CD), with
multiple additional I&I indications planned.

Our management team has significant public and private biotech company experience in the development
of immunoregulatory drugs and a proven track record in raising capital, IPO and M&A for effectively
accelerating drug candidates into and through late-stage clinical development. We are on a mission
to develop safer and more effective therapeutics that address the unmet needs of patients with
inflammatory and autoimmune diseases.

[About NImmune][13]

What is Nourish?

Nourish is a Telehealth nutrition counseling platform that connects patients with Registered
Dietitian Nutritionists (RDNs). We're available in all 50 states and have a network of 9,000+
dietitians who specialize across dozens of conditions and health goals.

Here's how it works: after signing up and verifying your insurance, you browse our dietitian
directory, choose a provider who fits your needs, and book a telehealth appointment via Zoom. Your
first session is a comprehensive assessment where your dietitian gets to know your health history,
goals, and lifestyle and builds a personalized care plan. Follow-up sessions put that plan into
action with ongoing coaching, accountability, and adjustments over time.

Between sessions, you can message your dietitian, log meals, track progress, and access recipes and
resources through the Nourish app. 94% of our patients pay $0 out-of-pocket — Nourish handles all
insurance verification and claim submissions so you can focus on your health.

What is a registered dietitian? Why should I see a dietitian?

Registered Dietitian Nutritionists (RDNs) are health professionals specializing in food and
nutrition. Dietitians provide a behavioral health approach to nutritional care to help you reach
your long-term health goals. To learn more about our approach to care, click [here][90]. 

Registered Dietitian Nutritionist (RDN) is a nationally recognized credential. At Nourish, all our
dietitians are RDNs, which means that they have completed a Bachelor or Master’s degree in
Nutrition, passed a national exam, and complete a number of ongoing continuing education credits
annually.

Are dietitians the same thing as nutritionists?

No, they are not the same. The title "nutritionist" is not a protected title, which means that
anyone, including yourself, can call themselves a nutritionist. At Nourish, all our providers are
Registered Dietitian Nutritionists (RDN) which is a legally protected title. Registered Dietitian
Nutritionists must complete a Bachelor or Master's degree in Nutrition, pass a national exam, and
complete a number of ongoing continuing education credits annually. [Read our blog post to learn
more!][91]

With Nourish, you can be sure that you are speaking with licensed health professionals that have
been trained in nutrition and dietary intervention. To learn more about our approach to care, please
click [here][92].

How many appointments will I need?

It depends on your goals and health conditions, and your dietitian will give you a personalized
recommendation during your first session. That said, here's a general sense of what to expect:

Most patients meet with their dietitian weekly or biweekly, especially at the start of care. Initial
sessions & follow ups will typically be 50–60 minutes. As you build momentum and healthy habits
become more routine, many patients space appointments out to monthly check-ins.

There are no minimums or commitments — your care plan is entirely flexible and adjusts as your needs
change!

Do providers at Nourish work with children?

Yes, at Nourish we have many dietitians who specialize in working with children. We have experience
in dealing with nutrition issues related to children, including overweight/underweight, diabetes,
hypercholesterolemia, food allergies, and eating disorders.

Will my insurance cover my sessions?

94% of in-network patients pay $0 out-of-pocket. Use the [coverage calculator][93] to verify. All
appointments are backed by the Nourish Guarantee. Nourish verifies your insurance coverage before
your appointment and handles all claim submissions!

What is Nourish?

Nourish is a Telehealth nutrition counseling platform that connects patients with Registered
Dietitian Nutritionists (RDNs). We're available in all 50 states and have a network of 9,000+
dietitians who specialize across dozens of conditions and health goals.

Here's how it works: after signing up and verifying your insurance, you browse our dietitian
directory, choose a provider who fits your needs, and book a telehealth appointment via Zoom. Your
first session is a comprehensive assessment where your dietitian gets to know your health history,
goals, and lifestyle and builds a personalized care plan. Follow-up sessions put that plan into
action with ongoing coaching, accountability, and adjustments over time.

Between sessions, you can message your dietitian, log meals, track progress, and access recipes and
resources through the Nourish app. 94% of our patients pay $0 out-of-pocket — Nourish handles all
insurance verification and claim submissions so you can focus on your health.

What is a registered dietitian? Why should I see a dietitian?

Registered Dietitian Nutritionists (RDNs) are health professionals specializing in food and
nutrition. Dietitians provide a behavioral health approach to nutritional care to help you reach
your long-term health goals. To learn more about our approach to care, click [here][90]. 

Registered Dietitian Nutritionist (RDN) is a nationally recognized credential. At Nourish, all our
dietitians are RDNs, which means that they have completed a Bachelor or Master’s degree in
Nutrition, passed a national exam, and complete a number of ongoing continuing education credits
annually.

Are dietitians the same thing as nutritionists?

No, they are not the same. The title "nutritionist" is not a protected title, which means that
anyone, including yourself, can call themselves a nutritionist. At Nourish, all our providers are
Registered Dietitian Nutritionists (RDN) which is a legally protected title. Registered Dietitian
Nutritionists must complete a Bachelor or Master's degree in Nutrition, pass a national exam, and
complete a number of ongoing continuing education credits annually. [Read our blog post to learn
more!][91]

With Nourish, you can be sure that you are speaking with licensed health professionals that have
been trained in nutrition and dietary intervention. To learn more about our approach to care, please
click [here][92].

How many appointments will I need?
